whatAreCookiesText: Cookies are small text files that are placed on your computer or mobile device when you visit a website. They are widely used to make websites work more efficiently and provide information to website owners.
essentialCookiesText: These cookies are necessary for the website to function and cannot be switched off. They are usually set in response to your actions, such as setting privacy preferences or logging in.
analyticsCookiesText: These cookies help us understand how visitors interact with our website by collecting and reporting information anonymously. We use Google Analytics to improve our services.
marketingCookiesText: These cookies track your online activity to help advertisers deliver more relevant advertising or limit how many times you see an advertisement.
preferenceCookiesText: These cookies enable the website to remember information that changes the way the site behaves or looks, such as your preferred language or region.

googleAnalyticsDesc: For website analytics and performance monitoring
web3ProvidersDesc: For wallet connection and blockchain interactions
managingCookiesText: You have several options to manage or delete cookies:
ourCookieSettingsText: Click the "Cookie Settings" button in the footer to manage your preferences on our website.
browserSettingsText: Most browsers allow you to refuse or delete cookies. The methods vary by browser and version. Visit your browser's help section for instructions.
impactDisablingCookiesText: If you choose to disable cookies, some features of our website may not function properly. Essential cookies cannot be disabled as they are necessary for the website to work.
